 G. V. Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar’s supernatural horror film Immortal to premiere on Sony LIV on October 30

 Tamil film Immortal, written and directed by debutant Mariyappan Chinna, is set to premiere on Sony LIV on October 30, 2026. Blending romance, mystery and supernatural horror, the film will be available in five languages: Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada and Hindi.
 Set in present-day Chennai, Immortal follows Magi, played by G. V. Prakash Kumar, a printing press worker searching for an affordable place to stay. His life takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Sindhu, played by Kayadu Lohar, a mysterious woman who offers him a room in her luxurious apartment at a surprisingly low rent.
 --> 
 What initially appears to be a fortunate opportunity soon takes a disturbing turn as strange events begin to unfold. As Magi gets drawn deeper into Sindhu’s world, he finds himself confronting a mystery rooted in the past, revealing a darker side of attraction and an unsettling connection that refuses to remain hidden.
 Speaking about his character, G. V. Prakash Kumar said, “Magi is a very relatable guy who finds himself in a situation he never expected. What I enjoyed about the character is that he keeps discovering things along with the audience. There is a sense of curiosity, fear and uncertainty running through his journey, and that made the role exciting for me. I am happy that audiences can now experience Immortal on Sony LIV and discover the mystery for themselves.”
 The film also features T. M. Karthik, Kumar Natarajan, Lollu Sabha Maaran, Aaditya Kathir, Arshu Maharjan, Pema Tsamchoe and Sunita Shrestha in prominent roles.
 With its mix of romance, suspense and supernatural horror, Immortal promises to take viewers into a mysterious world where an ordinary encounter leads to unexpected revelations.
 Immortal premieres on October 30, 2026, exclusively on Sony LIV.
